Dated correction: same-context unsandboxed GNU coreutils 9.11 and the unchanged Wasm command both create 05777 under the observed winter:wheel parent. The earlier native 01777 observation used a different restricted sandbox and was a false compatibility diagnosis. This finite mask independently requires setuid and sticky; group-dependent setgid and ordinary rwx bits remain outside its scope. Special-bit comparisons require the same execution security context and a verified setuid capability precondition.

Independent same-context unrestricted Darwin GNU coreutils 9.11 probes under both inherited-wheel and primary-staff parents require 01777 for symbolic +t. Darwin initial directory creation drops sticky, forcing GNU's post-creation chmod of the full symbolic result. This differs from Linux's retained-sticky 01755. The expected mode predates the product repair; an immutable Darwin oracle profile remains required for upstream parity.
